items.hook: Siegfried Trebitsch was an Austrian playwright, translator, novelist and poet.

items.hook: NY 272 was assigned as part of the 1930 renumbering of state highways in New York and has not been altered since.
items.body: New York State Route 272 (NY 272) is a north–south state highway in the western portion of New York in the United States. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The Iron Dream is a metafictional 1972 alternate history novel by American author Norman Spinrad.
items.body: The book has a nested narrative that tells a story within a story. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Pianist was a 1998 Catalan-language film directed by Mario Gas, and based on a novel by Manuel Vázquez Montalbán.
items.body: It tells the story of two musicians, played in their old age by Serge Reggiani and Laurent Terzieff and in their youth by Pere Ponce and Jordi Mollà, who were friends at the onset of the Spanish Civil War. The world is stranger than it lets on.
